LOOK: A new section of 7th Avenue in Bonifacio Global City has officially opened to traffic as of February 7, 2026. The stretch runs from 34th Street near the former Lexus Manila site to Justicia Drive and 32nd Street, adding another east-west route within the district.

The opening is expected to ease congestion slightly, particularly for vehicles coming from Mandaluyong and Pasig entering BGC via Kalayaan Bridge. While it will not solve traffic issues on its own, the added road space should help improve traffic flow during peak hours and provide motorists with an additional access option into the area.

Report by Kenneth M. del Rosario
